items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that after Amendment No. 1, all other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force. Specifically, the amendment states, "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force" [1].

This means that the original terms of the Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, except for the amended clause 3.1, continue to be valid. These include the services provided, the original fee structure, the term and termination provisions, and liability limitations. For example, the original agreement specifies that "Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000" [3], and that the agreement "continues until terminated" with a 60-day termination notice [3][3].

The liability limitation of EUR 150,000 per event also remains in effect [3].

items.question: Under which clause of the MSA was the change of control notice given?
items.answer: The change of control notice was given under Clause 14.2 of the MSA. The notice states, "We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc." [2].

evidence.quote: We write under Clause 14.2 of the Master Services Agreement dated 2 March 2026 to notify you of an expected change of control of Harrowgate Systems Inc.

items.question: Does the Kestrel storage agreement have a fixed end date?
items.answer:
The Kestrel storage agreement does not have a fixed end date. Instead, it continues until terminated, with either party able to terminate it with 60 days' written notice [1][1].

There is no mention of a fixed end date in the agreement or any amendments to it.

evidence.quote: This Agreement continues until terminated.
Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice.

items.question: Which terms of the storage agreement remain in force after Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The documents indicate that after Amendment No. 1, the terms of the storage agreement that remain in force include all terms except those specifically amended.

The relevant source states: "All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force." [1]

Other terms from the original Kestrel Storage Services Agreement, such as the monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, the right to terminate with 60 days' notice, and the liability limit of EUR 150,000 per event, are not amended by Amendment No. 1 and therefore remain in force.

The monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000 is specified in the original agreement: "Client shall pay a monthly storage fee of EUR 4,000, invoiced on the first business day of each month." [3]

The right to terminate with 60 days' notice is also part of the original agreement: "Either party may terminate this Agreement on sixty (60) days' written notice." [3]

The liability limit of EUR 150,000 per event is also part of the original agreement: "Provider's total liability for loss of or damage to stored goods is limited to EUR 150,000 per event." [3]

evidence.quote: All other terms of the Storage Services Agreement remain in force.

items.question: How sure is Jonas Ekberg of the time the alarm sounded?
items.answer:
The documents state that Jonas Ekberg recalled the temperature alarm sounding at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026, but he was not sure of the exact minute [1].

The documents in this matter do not answer that.

evidence.quote: I recall that the temperature alarm sounded at about 02:40 on 18 June 2026. I am not sure of the exact minute.

items.question: What was the Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1?
items.answer:
The Kestrel monthly storage fee before Amendment No. 1 was EUR 4,000, as stated in the original Storage Services Agreement [2].

Amendment No. 1 changed this amount to EUR 4,600, effective 1 June 2026 [1].
